items.claim: Hex row shows and compares against held typed text instead of the picker's color
Text-row edit survives its submenu closing, so keys go to a row no panel shows
Swatches draw at the alpha the row opened with, but write the alpha held now
Typed text longer than its row draws over the label and outside the panel
items.note: It now scrolls to keep the caret inside the value column and is clipped there. The scroll offset is recomputed from the caret on every draw rather than kept between draws, so after a click in a scrolled draft the text can shift under the pointer.

items.claim: `attachMenuHost` throws when `toCanvas` or `canvasSize` is passed as `undefined`
Swatch rows are exposed as checkboxes though they are mutually exclusive
